label: Request context
description: What this feature reads from the HTTP request beyond its body and route: the caller's user agent, forwarded to the API on a registration, and the caller's tenant, which the customer stores scope their records by.

agent.label: The caller's user agent
agent.description: absent when the caller sent none; the header is then not forwarded

tenant.label: The caller's tenant
tenant.description: Written into the session at sign-in from what the directory said about the account; every customer kept in a store belongs to one
